obligations.note: The new rule in retention.py#purge_due skips every closed payee with category 'tax_authority', so their NPI is never purged after the 84-month retention period. RET-1 allows only legal hold to stop a due purge, and the change adds no policy value or legal-hold basis for this category.

The change deviates from RET-1, but the exception register has no entry for RET-1 or payments.retention. The only entries are EXC-0141 (SES-1, expired), EXC-0167 (LOG-1, mortgage) and EXC-0172 (withdrawn), so nothing makes the deviation acceptable.
Ticket CHG-26374 is standard and was approved by change manager Erik Brandt at 2026-10-05T02:53Z, before the PR opened. Its component payments.retention covers the only touched file, retention.py.
Mara Costa approved the code_review. She is a payments change_approver and a different person from the author, Aisha Bello (none of Bello's addresses match).
The code_review approval names head commit 12376ec4, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json reports success on head 12376ec4 from ci-runner-06 on 2026-10-06. The attached JUnit report, however, is timestamped 2026-10-23, after the review time of 2026-10-08, and comes from host dev-laptop-7.local, so it cannot be tied to that run. Also, no test exercises the new tax_authority branch, although the PR description says unit tests were updated.
The only touched path, retention.py, maps to payments.retention, which is not security_sensitive, so no security_review is required.
No protected path (controls/, control tests, ci/) is changed, so no control_owner approval is required.
The change is not an emergency (emergency=false, ticket type standard), so no PIR is due.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers retention.py, so this change lapses no prior evidence.

summary: PR-1222 makes the payments retention job skip purging NPI for closed tax-authority payees indefinitely. RET-1 requires closed payee NPI to be purged after the approved retention period, with legal hold as the only exemption, so the change violates it. No approved exception covers RET-1 for payments.retention. Ticket and approvals are in order, but the CI JUnit evidence is itself questionable: it postdates the review time and comes from a personal machine. The change is rejected.
